commentary: Chahar to Boult, B0$ Bowled!! Leg stump out of the ground. Length delivery on the leg stump, Boult slogs and misses. Oh Chahar is limping after delivering that ball. Looks like the hammie. He's stretching it. Hope it's not too serious as he wants to continue.  B1$

Ngidi to Pollard, B0$ Caught by Dhoni!! Edged and taken. All those bowlers in the CPL, hope you note this length. Back of a length is the toughest to hit. If you have pace, it's a no brainer for you to use at the death to power-hitters than bowling freebies in the name of trying the fancied yorker, for which the margin of error is very less. Pollard slogs and gets a thick outside edge through to Dhoni. CSK have stolen 10 runs off the total. B1$
Sam Curran to Pollard, B0$, this is really poor bowling! Low full toss down leg, Pollard flicks, fine leg in, it's a sin to bowl there. Pollard calmly glances knowing the field and collects four

Ngidi to Krunal Pandya, B0$ Caught by Dhoni!! That's a soft dismissal! Nothing back of a length delivery down leg, Krunal tried to glance fine, but got an edge and Dhoni was sharp moving to his right and grabbing that. Unlucky! Krunal started walking before the decision. Can CSK stage a comeback and stall MI? B1$

Chawla to Pollard, B0$, na, na, na, just waited for it to land in his zone. With that sort of a form in CPL, he won't mishit those. Easy to the eye straight loft into the sightscreen. Expect the bowler to push it quick and short?

Jadeja to Hardik Pandya, B0$ Caught by du Plessis!! You are kidding me Faf! Surely you can't be taking these nimble footed catches twice in an over. Jadeja bowled full, so Pandya went for a loft over long-off, hit it really flat and hard, Faf had to move to his right a bit this time, yet he timed the jump brilliantly, released the ball as he was going over the rope and then swallowed it again. Big wicket this for CSK, will make a difference of 10 runs at least to the final total. B1$

Ngidi to Saurabh Tiwary, B0$, oh Lungi! He's the old fit self that he is. The rhythm isn't there, the strides aren't intense. Full delivery, Tiwary charges and slaps wide of mid-off. Can't be bowling full with mid-off in

Ngidi to Saurabh Tiwary, B0$, shortish and Tiwary has pulled. This is a seriously good cameo from Tiwary. Came in at the fall of two big wickets, but kept the shots coming. This one's pulled over mid-wicket

Jadeja to Hardik Pandya, B0$, now that is some shot! Don't think many would hit that so far from that length. Not really short and leg stump line, but went back, despite not using the depth of the crease and being cramped, he swivelled and pulled it over the backward square leg boundary and that seems to have cleared the ground. All those gym sessions, that's great flexibility

Jadeja to Hardik Pandya, B0$, that's all the amount of respect Pandya had in the tank. He loves spin. As soon as Jadeja bowled a little full, he went down on his knees to power it over deep mid-wicket

Chahar to Suryakumar Yadav, B0$ Caught by Sam Curran!! In the airrr, has he timed this? No pace on the ball, to be honest can't blame the pitch for this dismissal. Was right in the slot to tee off, but Suryakumar was hanging back for this one, didn't go through fully and sort of chipped it, long-on steadies and takes this around his left shoulder. B1$
Jadeja to Saurabh Tiwary, B0$, short enough and wide enough, slapped away for four through backward point. MI regaining momentum through these two again

Jadeja to Saurabh Tiwary, B0$, Jadeja gets it right into the slot for Tiwary who lofts it downwind to clear long-off. The wind was the key here. Don't think he struck it that well but the wind made sure it carried

Sam Curran to Suryakumar Yadav, B0$, back of a length, cutting away across off. There should've been no room for Suryakumar here, but he's manufactured it for himself by stepping away. But even from his modified position, the width isn't quite there to free the arms. Still, he's able to scythe this through baclward point. Beats third man's diving effort
Jadeja to Suryakumar Yadav, B0$, beautiful from Suryakumar as he clears the front leg and lifts this delivery over extra cover. Great timing on it to beat long-off

Chawla to Rohit, B0$ Caught by Sam Curran!! Such a soft dismissal as Rohit just chips this into the hands of mid-off. Half-hearted loft, never went through with it and to make it worse the timing isn't there at all. Bounces off the toe-end and it's a dolly for Curran. The MI captain gone early. B1$
Ngidi to de Kock, B0$, he's on an absolute roll. Succeeds with the scoop this time, something which he was trying earlier in the over. Walks across, gets a length ball and ramps it over short fine

Ngidi to de Kock, B0$, four more for de Kock, although this has come off a perfectly decent delivery. Back of a length at the top of off, and it's been met with disdain from de Kock who clears his front leg and slogs it over mid-on. Almost went all the way
Ngidi to de Kock, B0$, full in the slot for de Kock who pumps it over mid-off. Really taking the bowling on, although the bowling is really ordinary at this stage
Chahar to de Kock, B0$, slower ball at 119kph, sits up for de Kock from the middle of the pitch as he heaves through midwicket. Chahar's not been great here at the start

Sam Curran to Rohit, B0$, plenty of width outside off, the hard part for Rohit is to stretch out to meet it. So it's commendable that his timing is still so great as he smears it through backward point
Chahar to de Kock, B0$, been a rusty start from Chahar, who now doles out a half-volley on the pads of de Kock. Gleefully flicked through midwicket, the timing is superb

Boult to du Plessis, B0$, no fuss. Boult overcompensates with one that's short, into the body and gets swiped into deep mid-wicket. Again, no fuss, not even a celebration. B1$, and that's exactly what this CSK are
Boult to du Plessis, B0$, sliced over point. Boult goes round the wicket and dishes out a floaty lazy non-warmed-up delivery that's full, wide and worthy of a dispatch. Yep, over backward

Bumrah to Dhoni, no run, B0$You'd think when he reviews from behind the stumps, he'd know when he hasn't nicked it. It was the typical strategy -- short, incoming bouncer, which MS pulls and apparently gloves away to the keeper. Nope, clear daylight between glove and ball, and more daylight between bat and ball. But there was a noise, which probably was his clicking bat
Bumrah to du Plessis, 1 run, a sort of a miscued punch, wide of extra cover, B0$ B1$
Bumrah to du Plessis, B0$, sealed some more. Another poor delivery, slow, short, wide. Faf has all the time he needs, staying up tall and slicing over cover in the ring with nobody behind

Bumrah to Sam Curran, B0$ Caught by Pattinson!! Misbah moment? A scoop, after shuffling across to a slower delivery, but unlike Sreesanth, Pattinson has to backpedal and hold on. Doesn't matter, this game's sealed. B1$
Bumrah to Sam Curran, B0$, game over. Bumrah tries the slower one, but Curran - in some mood - picks it early and nails it right off the screws, over deep mid-wicket

Krunal Pandya to Sam Curran, B0$, there's nobody in the deep on the off-side, but Pandya for some reason still wants to bowl a half-tracker with lots of width. Curran won't complain, slicing it over cover, which is all he had to do
Krunal Pandya to Sam Curran, B0$, low full toss. Curran stays crouched, gets under, and boom. Swinging slog, into cow corner

Krunal Pandya to Jadeja, B0$ Lbw!! Plumb. Dead. Gone. A straight delivery, angling in and the Jadeja's been fooled by the pace as he plays all around this with his flick after plonking his front leg in front of off. It can't get easier for umpires, and for Jadeja with the decision to not review. B1$
Pattinson to Jadeja, B0$, nothing dicey here. Pattinson feeds him a high full toss outside off and Jadeja neatly opens his bat face to carve it backward of point
Pattinson to Jadeja, B0$, filthy loose a line. Full, leg-lined and Jadeja just waits for it to get close before whipping it really fine

Rahul Chahar to Rayudu, B0$ Caught&Bowled!! Nobody's taking his catches, and so what if he needs to sprint backwards for this. Yeah, he does. Rayudu, third time unlucky, has a dance, a hoick, only getting the toe-end and skewing up a skier. It's somewhere around mid-on, and the run-dive's more than good enough. But forget that, it's been a top knock from India's best number four who wasn't in the World Cup. B1$

Rahul Chahar to Rayudu, 1 run, B0$ -- a massively tough one, but nevertheless, it's put down. Rayudu reverse-sweeps, and Krunal Pandya - backward point - dives to his right, gets both palms, and can't hold on
Bumrah to du Plessis, B0$, 144.5kph. Slight width, wth Faf backing away to snatch a lot more to slap this with lots of bottom-hand, past Rohit's dive at short cover
Rahul Chahar to Rayudu, B0$, oooo, wow. Just wow. Rayudu continues dancing, going inside-out, and then holding his pose. Yep, extra cover

Bumrah to Rayudu, B0$, B1$, tennis forehand. A walk, clearing the front leg and a swat downtown, with Bumrah getting a fingertip as he tries pulling his hand out of the way. Oh and also, B2$ -- and revenge for the 2019 WC is well and truly complete
Krunal Pandya to Rayudu, B0$, horrible drag down this. Rayudu's charged down, made it into one in his slot and smoking a cross-batted heave over cow corner

Rahul Chahar to Rayudu, B0$, back-to-back sloppy efforts. A tossed up delivery outside off and Rayudu chips it to deep cover where Boult makes a mess of it. Was charging in to avoid the batsmen from taking the second, and ends up gifting them a boundary. Rohit Sharma wouldn't be a happy skipper with those two boundaries..
Rahul Chahar to Rayudu, B0$, not a great effort by Bumrah at short fine leg, he should have stopped this. Was down the leg side as Rayudu swept it past the man at short fine leg

Rahul Chahar to du Plessis, B0$, B1$ All about timing, this shot. Shimmies down the track and although the ball sticks into the surface - the class of du Plessis takes over. Goes inside out with a checked lofted drive and manages to beat Surya at long-off

Bumrah to Rayudu, B0$, that will hurt. The free-hit has gone the distance as Rayudu lines up against the short ball and clubs it off the back foot over wide long-on. Sweetly timed maximum. Started with four dot balls and ends up conceding 14. Life's harsh sometimes
Bumrah to Rayudu, B0$, B1$, B2$ Not that short, neither too full. Sets up for Rayudu who makes use of the slight width and flashes it over point. No ball. Free hit coming!

Ngidi to Jofra Archer, B0$, B1$, B2$ - this is a stunning cameo from Archer - length ball at the stumps, Archer backs away and lifts it high and over long-off.. and the third umpire decides that the front-foot is just over, called as a no-ball

Ngidi to Jofra Archer, B0$, B1$,  a B2$, length ball at the stumps, Archer clears his front leg and thwacks it flat and hard, wide of long-on for a maximum - worse, Ngidi has overstepped by a massive margin and a B3$
Ngidi to Jofra Archer, B0$, B1$, that's a clean hit from Archer, picked the slower ball early, extended his arms and lifted it high and over long-off for a maximum

Sam Curran to Smith, B0$ Caught by Kedar Jadhav!! CSK are pulling things back very nicely, this was a length ball at the pads, Smith shuffled across and whipped it firmly, hit it in the air and straight down the throat of Kedar at deep mid-wicket. Smith is annoyed with himself as he walks back - suddenly, 200 looks very distant now. B1$

Sam Curran to Riyan Parag, B0$ Caught by Dhoni!! Edged and caught - A straightforward dismissal and the Super Kings are pulling things back nicely. Two wickets in the over for Curran - shortened his length and angled one across the right-hander, Parag was looking to run it past the keeper, got it too fine though and MS did the rest - dived across to his right and the ball got stuck in his fingertips, he clasped it cleanly on the second attempt. B1$

Sam Curran to Rahul Tewatia, B0$ Lbw!! That looked plumb and Rahul Tewatia has been given OUT LBW.B1$. It's a fair delivery, looks like no bat and UltraEdge confirms it, directly onto his toes, bang in front of middle and it's crashing low into the middle. Three REDS and Rahul Tewatia is OUT. A poor review from Tewatia, think he thought he got an inside edge. Almost the perfect yorker from Curran, turned out to be a low full-toss, Tewatia swung all around it and missed. B2$

Jadeja to Smith, B0$, B1$ - it's not happening in the field for CSK - Sam Curran, the culprit, this was tossed up slower and wider of off, Smith had to reach out and didn't get enough on the lofted drive - went flat and and wide of long-off. Curran stretched out with both hands, got to the ball and then let it burst through - was right in front of the ropes and that perhaps put him off

Ngidi to Smith, B0$ Miller Run Out!! 1 run completed. Appeal for a run-out at the bowler's end, Miller dived, has it saved him? A flat throw and a good pick-up. No, the dive's not good enough and Miller falls for a diamond duck on his Royals debut. Unfortunate way to get dismissed - it didn't help that Miller lost his bat as well, could have saved him else. On a length and at the stumps, worked in front of square on the on-side and it was Smith's call for the second. Miller responded well, but lost his bat as he dived - good throw from Gaikwad and Kedar was at hand to break the stumps. B1$

Ngidi to Samson, B0$ Caught by Chahar!! That is the end of the Samson show - he's furious with himself as he walks back. Would have been a wide had he let it go - but the adrenaline was pumping and he couldn't hold back - went chasing after that and lifted it towards deep cover - Chahar ran in, took it awkwardly around his chest, reverse cupped - it threatened to pop out, but he manages to clutch it safely. Was the slower short ball and Samson didn't have the pace on the shot. Some relief for the CSKians, they clearly looked rattled. B1$
Jadeja to Samson, B0$, B1$ tossed up on off, Samson gets a big stride forward and then lifts it nonchalantly over long-off, went a long way into the stands

Chawla to Samson, B0$, this is bad bowling now. He is just feeding it in his slot. Flighted and lands it on a fullish length, right where Samson likes it, he lofts through the line and clearing the fence has not been difficult for him, well over long-off

Chawla to Smith, B0$, Smith has a piece of the leggie. 28 runs off the over. Chawla went fast and short outside off, Smith does not commit to the shot, waits for it and then smacks it over extra cover.

Chawla to Samson, B0$, "looks like he is having a net," quips Gavaskar on air. He is treating them that away and has even impressed his skipper at the other end. Flighted and lands full, Samson clears his front leg and goes straight, that high backlift allows him to have a clean swing and it goes over the roof
Chawla to Samson, 1 run, B0$ Samson has turned it around for the Royals. Just a bat raise and is congratulated by his skipper. Quicker delivery outside off, Samson cracks it to sweeper cover

Chawla to Samson, B0$, this is now officially a carnage. Chawla goes wide of off-stump and Samson was happy with that line, good stride forward and lofts it with the spin over extra cover. Another one out in the car park

Jadeja to Samson, B0$, Jadeja put under pressure straightaway. Samson does not want him to settle. This is touch wide of off-stump and he goes with the spin, nice clean bat swing to take it over long-off. Might have gone out of the ground
Jadeja to Samson, B0$, he's dealing in sixes at the moment, third for him. Drifting in from the round the wicket angle, Samson swings through the line and smokes it all the way over wide long-on

Chahar to Samson, B0$, wow! That is some shot. He looks so elegant when on song. Picked the short of length delivery early, stayed on the front foot while transferring his weight back, pulls it handsomely over deep square leg and cleared the field comfortably
Sam Curran to Samson, B0$, cracking shot! That's more like it. Short of length around the hips, Samson gets into a good position this time and smashes the pull into the deep mid-wicket stands

Chahar to Jaiswal, B0$ Caught&Bowled!! Oh no! Good comeback by Chahar. He persisted with the short ball and got it higher than the previous ball. Jaiswal went for the pull and only managed a top-edge, goes straight up and both Chahar and Dhoni converge, in the end it is the bowler who gets there first. B1$
Tom Curran to Dhoni, B0$, THWACK! MS Dhoni in the final over is a sight to behold! Slams this short ball, pulling it over deep square leg for third successive six. B1$
Tom Curran to Dhoni, B0$, what's in that cricket bat? A slower one on a length, and that's a no-no to the world's best finisher - on his knee and he's mowed that over wide long-on for six! B1$

Tom Curran to Dhoni, B0$, MS Dhoni, far too late in the final over, dispatches this over deep midwicket for six! A Dhoni six, and the world goes crazy! My neighbours have gone crazy! Right in the slot and that's carted into the Sharjah streets...

Jofra Archer to du Plessis, B0$ Caught by Samson! Short at the body, du Plessis loses his shape, instinctively worried about his fingers - he has history - and goes for a half-hearted hook. Gets a top-edge, as it lobs up towards the leg-gully area where Samson comes across to collect the catch. B1$
Jofra Archer to du Plessis, B0$, drops it short and into the body, but Faf picks the slower one - waits for it to arrive and clubs the pull over deep midwicket for six!

Tom Curran to du Plessis, B0$, half-volley outside off, clears his frontfoot, and makes it 4 out of 5 balls dispatched for six! Clobbers this over long-off! That's the fifty-stand - only 7 of which have been scored by Dhoni. Faf is in rhythm...
Unadkat to du Plessis, B0$, B1$, and it's been brought up by one of the cleanest, straightest swings of the blade down the ground. Another six that seems to have cleared that diminutive Sharjah roof!
Unadkat to du Plessis, B0$, far too slow for even two bat-swings - 105.2km/h - and this ridiculously slow short ball has been clubbed over deep mid-wicket with a late pull for six!
Unadkat to du Plessis, B0$, charges this slower one and lifts this over long-on for six! Absolutely smoked that over one of the longer boundaries here at Sharjah!
Rahul Tewatia to du Plessis, B0$, backs away into the on-side, Tewatia serves one up in the slot, and clobbers this over long-on for a gigantic six! More of these needed. Many more.

Rahul Tewatia to du Plessis, B0$, B1$Parag at the boundary has woefully misjudged it, and not for the first time, the outfielder is pointing at the floodlights! Charges down and carts it, with a bit of a hind-limb pirouette, over long-on for six!

Tom Curran to Kedar Jadhav, B0$ Caught by Samson! Charges, and tries to swing this over the on-side, but gets it close to the shoulder of the outside edge and almost over the 'keeper, but Samson can do no wrong today! Leaps to take that one, and it sticks!  Maginificent catch to get rid of Jadhav! B1$

Rahul Tewatia to Ruturaj Gaikwad, B0$ Stumped!! Charges down first ball and is nowhere near it. Ruturaj Gaikwad, finding a place in the team today, goes for a duck. Third wicket for Tewatia, who kept this wide outside off and once again ensured the length's short enough. Easy stumping. B1$

Rahul Tewatia to Sam Curran, B0$ Stumped!! Tewatia gets the better of him this time. He shortens the length far enough to give room for the googly to turn past the outside edge. Curran, who's running down the pitch again, doesn't back out despite not reaching to the pitch. He slogs in vain. And because he is so far down, there's no going back either despite a valiant effort to do so. Neat stumping from Samson. B1$

Rahul Tewatia to Sam Curran, B0$, there's six more. Tewatia may not be feeding it into the slot for him, but Curran is creating his own length with excellent use of the feet. Gets close enough to this and hammers it back down the ground
Rahul Tewatia to Sam Curran, B0$, Curran races down, ensures he gets right to the pitch of this googly and smokes it downtown. Already injecting life into the chase and he's only 3 balls in

Rahul Tewatia to Watson, B0$ Bowled!! The pull, the famed Watson pull, has brought about his downfall. Problem is the length isn't short at all. He's just trying to manufacture it out of nothing. Fails badly as this skids through onto his back pad and crashes into leg stump. May have been fooled by the trajectory actually. Tewatia kept it quite flat, pushing it through off the front of his hand. May have caused him to believe it was shorter than it was. Watson's furious with himself. B1$

Tom Curran to Watson, B0$, this is not good bowling. Dare I say Tom Curran doesn't have the pace to trouble Watson with the short ball. It's playing into his strengths. And he's absolutely nailing these pull shots
Tom Curran to Watson, B0$, short of length delivery around the hip, and if there's anyone you don't want to bowl this length at, it's Watson. Whips the pull away into the stands

Shreyas Gopal to Watson, B0$, there he goes, and B1$! Signature Watson this. So good with the pull shot against spin. Even deliveries that are slightly off in length, he pounces on them. This one, though, is a proper long hop and Watson just nails it over square leg
Unadkat to Vijay, B0$, there's the first boundary of the innings. Length ball on leg, Vijay whips it away fine enough to beat fine leg

Shivam Dube to Rahul, B0$, Rahul brings up the 200 in style. Dube misses his yorker by a long distance, this was right in the swinging arc, Rahul clears his front leg and pumps it into the first tier near long-on

Steyn to Rahul, B0$, he has had luck and this proves that today is his day. Good length ball around off, Rahul clears his front leg to have a heave to the on-side, the thick inside edge races past the the stumps

Steyn to Rahul, B0$, he is putting on a show now. Not leaving any delivery that is in his arc. This was full and outside off, Rahul stays leg-side to give the room to open his arms, opens the bat face and slices it over point. Another biggie..

Steyn to Rahul, B0$, oh my! That's disappeared into the top tier. Steyn is just too predictable with his slower deliveries, it is all back of a length stuff, Rahul waits and swings his bat at the right time, pumps it flat and all the way over deep mid-wicket

Steyn to Rahul, B0$, B1$ Fine innings from the Kings XI skipper. He has led from the front and has put his team ahead in this tie. Takes off his helmet and soaks in the applause from his team mates and owners. And does the "I don't hear anything" celebration that he does. Full delivery outside off, Rahul throws the kitchen sink and the outside edge flies over short third man

Steyn to Rahul, B0$, AB tries his best to pull off another one of his Superman catches. But is not able to. Slower delivery on the stumps, Rahul picks it away over backward square and he gets the elevation to beat a leaping AB. The South African tried to parry it in but he was not able to

Navdeep Saini to Rahul, 1 run, oh no! B0$ Kohli again. Another slower ball on a fullish length, Rahul tries his best to manufacture power, but doesn't manage to and skies it towards long-off, Kohli runs in and this was a much easier chance than the previous one. He wriggles his hand as to gesturing that the ball might have been wet due to dew

Navdeep Saini to Rahul, B0$, 116.8kph and Rahul is waiting for it. Saini has to mix it up. This one had width as well, Rahul throws his bat at the right time to bisect backward point and short third man

Steyn to Rahul, 1 run, B0$ Kohli has put one down in the deep. Low full toss and Rahul crouches low to whip it over the rope, he doesn't get enough to clear the long boundary in Dubai, Kohli moves to his right and might have just overran a bit. He tries to adjust and take it over his head, but the ball just doesn't stick. How costly will it be?

Steyn to Rahul, B0$, woah! That's smashed. Steyn became predictable there. Slower ball back of a length and Rahul was waiting for this, gets into position quickly and nails the pull flat over deep mid-wicket

Shivam Dube to Maxwell, B0$ Caught by Finch!! There's something about Dube. Batsmen feel they can take him on but that has not been the case. First Pooran and now Maxwell. Those are two big wickets especially in such a situation where they have to license to go after the bowling. Maxwell backs away and takes a step down, Dube cleverly bangs the slower delivery into the surface, the flat-batted shot does not have the elevation to go over, Finch takes a good low catch at cover. B1$
Chahal to Rahul, B0$, poor delivery and Rahul does not miss out. Drifts this leggie too far down leg and it is easy pickings for Rahul, he kneels down and sweeps it fine to the left of short fine leg

Navdeep Saini to Rahul, B0$, and Saini errs in length. He goes full and Rahul is just too good there, extension of the arms and lofts it over extra cover, the ball has enough to trickle into the fence

Navdeep Saini to Rahul, B0$, top-edge and it runs away to the fence. Rahul was in no control there. Sharp bouncer around the left shoulder, Rahul was late on the hook and hence the edge, flies right over Philippe. He then practices playing the ramp instead of the hook
U Yadav to Rahul, B0$, strays on the pads, and that's tickled away to the fine leg boundary for four! Yadav, Yadav, Yadav - you simply cannot do that...
U Yadav to Pooran, B0$, right in the slot, wide half-volley, and Pooran has just leant into a fabulous drive through the covers. Not even a dive in the infield can cut that off...

Chahal to Agarwal, B0$ Bowled! Knocked him over! Agarwal has no clue about that googly, hasn't read it out of the hand, leaves a gaping hole between the bat and pad trying to play the expansive inside out drive, as if to a leg-break, but that one turns in and crashes into the stumps of Agarwal. It's Yuzi again, who's picked up the King-pin (from the last game at least). B1$
Chahal to Rahul, B0$, tossed up but drifting into the dangerous pad-line, and he's thrashed the sweep away to the backward square leg boundary for four

Steyn to Agarwal, B0$, a 135km/h bouncer from Steyn, but Agarwal has picked it up, rocks back and nails the pull to the deep mid-wicket boundary for four. Not the best timing on that, but he's got it away...
Navdeep Saini to Rahul, B0$, half-volley, a rare one from Saini, and Rahul just has to step out as he crunches it through deep extra cover for four! Stunning shot!
U Yadav to Agarwal, B0$, into the pads, half-volley, and that's clipped away with ease through deep mid-wicket for four! Nope, ain't no white ball gonna swing in the third over - as KP points out...
Steyn to Rahul, B0$, slightly short, doesn't exactly rise, but width on offer - chopped off the attempted cut, over backward point and away to the boundary where Umesh Yadav dives in vain
Steyn to Rahul, B0$, back of a length, doesn't quite hurry on from the surface, and that's all class from Rahul - opens the face and steers it away to the deep backward point fence for four
U Yadav to Rahul, B0$, there's the loosener that spoils a good over - fuller length ball on the pads, clipped away to fine leg for four with just a tickle
Murugan Ashwin to Chahal, B0$ Lbw!! Misses the sweep and the finger goes up! B1$. Woah! Thats massive. B2$

Murugan Ashwin to Navdeep Saini, B0$ Bowled!! Shake of the head from Murugan Ashwin. Why did he bowl the leggie to the tailender and not target the sticks with a googly like this one, says Ashwin to himself. Saini lofts over the top, or he wanted to, misses and sneaks through the gate. B1$

Ravi Bishnoi to Washington Sundar, B0$ Caught by Agarwal!! Ravi Bishnoi, in his debut IPL, bags the purple cap in the second game. Five wickets for the youngster, third of the game. B1$, actually got only one wicket in the first game. So doesn't have the cap yet. Needs one more. He nicely floats and invites the lofted hit, Sundar was tempted to back himself and go for the big hit, mistimed it to long-on. B2$

Ravi Bishnoi to U Yadav, B0$ Bowled!! No, no! This is so poor from a senior pro who knows how exactly the IPL pans. Why not play out the overs!
